title: Amounts Already Received on a TRICARE Select Installment Settled by Draft
content:
Payments on the fee account of a fee-bearing **TRICARE Select** enrollment are applied to installments oldest first.

**Clause.** For a one-time bank draft on the latest installment: where the payments left once the earlier counted charges are settled reach the installment owed, the whole installment owed counts as already received; where some but less is left, what is left counts as already received; otherwise nothing counts as already received. What counts as already received on the latest installment is taken off the installment owed.

The earlier counted charges are the charges counted toward the past-due balance other than the latest installment; the payments are all payments posted on the fee account.

## Three outcomes

1. Payments left after the earlier counted charges are equal to or more than the installment owed: the whole installment owed counts as already received.
2. Some payment is left, but less than the installment owed: the amount left counts as already received.
3. Nothing is left: nothing counts as already received.

## Hypothetical figures (installment owed 99.18, earlier counted charges 198.36)

| Payments posted | Left | Already received |
|---|---|---|
| 297.54 | 99.18 | 99.18 |
| 250.00 | 51.64 | 51.64 |
| 198.36 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| 150.00 | none (48.36 unsettled) | 0.00 |
